name: oido-linkedin
description: Scrape and act on LinkedIn — profiles, companies, jobs, posts, feed, and messaging — by driving a real Chrome session with your li_at cookie. No official API.

settings.name: LINKEDIN_LI_AT
settings.description: Your LinkedIn session cookie value (cookie name li_at), copied from a logged-in browser's devtools. Expires periodically — replace it here when tools start failing with a sign-in error.

settings.name: LINKEDIN_HEADLESS
settings.description: Run Chrome headless. Set to false to watch it work locally while debugging a stuck scrape. Default: true.

settings.name: LINKEDIN_CHROME_PATH
settings.description: Optional path to a Chrome/Chromium binary, if auto-discovery doesn't find one on this host.
